rationale: The Help 3.2.0 matrix, dated September 24, lists Kubernetes 1.32–1.37 and Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0. The September 8 changelog lists Kubernetes 1.32–1.36 and Enterprise 10.6.0. Both describe the Queue secretKeyRef breaking change. Help places the SOK upgrade before Enterprise and distinguishes 3.x EULA acceptance. Preserve the different matrix/changelog scopes and the earlier corrected range as history.

exclusions: No universal Kubernetes maximum, Enterprise 11.x compatibility, app pairing, Cloud availability or authorization is established.
